title: Lens review
description: One lens reviewer's verdict on a task, the status of the findings it raised in an earlier round, and its findings in this round. It is the JSON form of the review file (see tools/swfactory/verdict.py); `codex exec --output-schema` accepts it as-is.

verdict.description: CHANGES when any blocker or major finding is listed or still not fixed, otherwise PASS.

findings.description: The findings of this round, at most the nit cap of nits. Empty when there are none.

id.description: A short id that is never reused across rounds, such as R3.

severity.description: blocker or major sends the task back; minor and nit do not.

location.description: file:line, or empty when the finding is not about one place.

summary.description: What is wrong and why it matters.

fix.description: A concrete change that resolves it.

prior.description: The status of each finding from the earlier round's review. Empty in the first round.

id.description: The id the finding had in the earlier round.
